Class SimulationEngine

java.lang.Object
org.example.Model.SimulationEngine
public class SimulationEngine extends Object
Controls the execution of the airport queue simulation. This class manages the event list, simulation clock progression, passenger arrivals, service points, system-level statistics, and CSV export of the simulation results. The simulation is processed event by event in chronological order until there are no more events to handle or the simulation ends.

    • SimulationEngine

      public SimulationEngine(double simulationEndTime, Configuration config)
      Creates a new simulation engine with the given end time and configuration. The constructor initializes the event list, service points, random seed, statistics, passenger storage, and arrival generator.

      simulationEndTime - time limit for generating new arrivals

    • getLittleLawQueueError

      public double getLittleLawQueueError()
      Calculates the average Little's Law queue error across all service points. The method iterates over all service points in the grouping list and includes only those that have completed at least one service. It then computes the average of their Little's Law error percentages.
      Returns:
      the average Little's Law queue error in percent for all service points; returns 0 if no service points have completed any services

    • updateArrivalLambda

      public void updateArrivalLambda(double newLambda)
      Updates the arrival rate (lambda) used by the passenger arrival generator. The new lambda value must be positive. If the arrival generator is an exponential distribution (Negexp), its mean is updated accordingly.
      Parameters:
      newLambda - new arrival rate parameter
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the lambda value is not positive

    • setServiceSpeedFactor

      public void setServiceSpeedFactor(double factor) throws Exception
      Updates the service speed factor used by all service points. The given factor is clamped to the allowed range and validated against the current arrival and traversal factors. If valid, the new factor is applied to every service point in the simulation.
      Parameters:
      factor - requested service speed factor
      Throws:
      Exception - if the factor combination is not valid

      Records that a passenger has completed the simulation. The method updates the total number of completed passengers and adds the passenger's total journey time to cumulative statistics.
      Parameters:
      passenger - passenger that completed the system

    • getTotalPassengersCompleted

      public int getTotalPassengersCompleted()

    • changeSpeed

      public void changeSpeed(double newTimeScale)
      Changes the simulation time scale used for real-time synchronization. The method re-anchors the current real time and simulation time so that future delays are calculated relative to the new speed.
      Parameters:
      newTimeScale - new time scale value
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the time scale is not positive

    • setSpeedMultiplier

      public void setSpeedMultiplier(double multiplier)
      Sets the overall simulation speed multiplier. The multiplier is converted into a time scale value that is used to synchronize simulation time with wall-clock time.
      Parameters:
      multiplier - new simulation speed multiplier
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the multiplier is not positive

    • setArrivalSpeedFactor

      public void setArrivalSpeedFactor(double factor) throws Exception
      Updates the arrival speed factor of the simulation. The factor is clamped to the allowed range and validated against the current service and traversal factors. If valid, the arrival rate generator is updated accordingly.
      Parameters:
      factor - requested arrival speed factor
      Throws:
      Exception - if the factor combination is not valid

    • setTraversalSpeedFactor

      public void setTraversalSpeedFactor(double factor) throws Exception
      Updates the traversal speed factor of the simulation. The factor is clamped to the allowed range and validated against the current arrival and service factors.
      Parameters:
      factor - requested traversal speed factor
      Throws:
      Exception - if the factor combination is not valid

    • applyScenario

      public void applyScenario(Scenario scenario)
      Applies a predefined simulation scenario. The scenario updates the passenger arrival rate and may also update service-time means for the service points based on configuration data.
      Parameters:
      scenario - scenario to apply

    • run

      public void run()
      Runs the main simulation loop. Events are processed in chronological order until the simulation stops or the event list becomes empty. The method supports step mode, optional real-time slowing using thread sleep, dynamic service-point adjustment, and automatic export of results when the simulation ends.

    • resetSimulation

      public void resetSimulation()
      Resets the simulation to its initial state. The event list, passenger data, statistics, simulation clock, random seed, and service points are reset, and the first arrival event is scheduled again.
